finalEditPrompt:

Edit target: the supplied burgundy VIP banner with a crown and plain throne on the right.
The user finds this version TOO SIMPLE, but found the earlier detailed palace version TOO BUSY. Produce a carefully art-directed MIDDLE GROUND: cinematic atmosphere with a few meaningful environmental details, softly defocused and subordinate to the words.

Preserve exactly the 1983 x 793 wide canvas, typography and text locations, sizes, wording and colors: silver-white "BÔNUS", enormous warm gold "VIP", and "Diário + Semanal + Mensal" on the narrow wine-colored plaque. Preserve the crown, its purple stones, purple cushion and their scale. No logo or domain.

Background changes: create a restrained sophisticated wine-red throne-room atmosphere. Add ONE large softly defocused architectural arch behind the right-hand throne, with a narrow aged rose-gold molding catching a subtle warm highlight. Add a small number of broad velvet curtain folds at the upper left edge and upper right corner, not across the lettering. A gentle diagonal shaft of dusty rose-gold light from upper right, very restrained volumetric haze, and two soft distant points of warm candlelike bokeh provide depth. Background is medium-low detail, about 60% calm dark wine negative space, with foreground/background separation. It should clearly read as an elegant interior rather than a flat color gradient, but not as a cluttered palace.
Throne: bring back a modest amount of refined gold molding around the top and sides, slim ornamental detail only, not heavy baroque carvings. Keep the burgundy seat velvet and central crown crisp. No additional furniture. Use a subtle softly reflective burgundy foreground to ground the throne.

Lighting/color: deep burgundy and oxblood shadows (#35141f, #521e32), muted wine-red curtain highlights, rose-gold side light, a discreet lavender rim on the purple cushion. Warm cinematic lighting, controlled contrast and soft depth of field. No navy or blue background.
Do NOT restore the dense original palace: no repeated pillars, no rows of arches, no ornate wallpaper, no hanging chandeliers, no large candlesticks, no coin piles, no scattered gems, no glitter field, no busy filigree. No people, no characters, no new copy, no br893.com, no logo, no amounts, no watermark. Keep all exact Portuguese text and accents intact. Premium balanced cinematic campaign.

prompts:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished production homepage promotional banner, full bleed opaque image, exact wide landscape 2.5:1 canvas approximately 2000 x 800 pixels.
Primary request: a cinematic VIP bonus campaign. Use a distinctly DIFFERENT BACKGROUND COLOR from the other plum-purple and midnight-blue banners: deep BURGUNDY / OXBLOOD with muted ROSE GOLD light. A luxury still life of a jeweled crown and velvet throne, with NO PEOPLE OR CHARACTERS.
Render ONLY this Portuguese text verbatim:
"BÔNUS VIP"
"Diário + Semanal + Mensal"
No other text. Preserve the Ô in BÔNUS and á in Diário and exactly two plus signs.
Composition: typography dominates the LEFT 65% of the image; a magnificent jeweled golden crown on a velvet cushion on the seat of an ornate gold throne fills the RIGHT 32%. Generous safe margins of 6% on sides, 8% top and 16% bottom. The very bottom must be clear for carousel controls. This artwork must stay legible at 300 x 120 pixels.
Typography: BÔNUS above an enormous VIP. BÔNUS is bold luminous silver-white with subtle lavender-gray bevels. VIP is the largest element, monumental warm champagne-gold sculpted letters with brushed metal faces, polished bevels, and deep wine-red extrusion and shadow. Below VIP, one clean, large, compact line "Diário + Semanal + Mensal" on a subtle dark wine-colored plaque with a thin muted rose-gold edge. All three words equally readable, silver-white letters, gold plus signs.
Scene: luxurious cinematic palace interior with deep wine-red velvet drapery, elegant mahogany shadowed arches, subtle rose-gold architectural details. On the right an unoccupied ornate gold throne upholstered in rich burgundy velvet. A beautiful large gold crown encrusted with amethyst and pale champagne gems rests on a PURPLE velvet cushion on its seat. The crown catches a dramatic warm rose-gold spotlight. A few purple gemstones and gold coins near the base. No figures, no people, no faces.
Color palette: burgundy #35141f, dark wine #521e32, muted mahogany #6f3447, dusty rose light #b97983, rose gold #d5a38c. Pearl-white #f7f2fa and champagne-gold #ffe3a3 typography. Purple accents only on the cushion and amethysts, harmonizing with a purple website. Background MUST read wine red, not purple or navy blue.
Lighting and finish: cinematic luxury product photography combined with polished realistic 3D lettering, dramatic controlled spotlights, soft volumetric haze, gentle silver rim light, deep rich shadows, velvet and brushed metal textures, depth of field. Premium feature-film campaign composition. Bright, highly readable headline.
Constraints: absolutely NO br893.com, NO URL, NO logo, NO brand text, NO watermark, NO extra words, NO numbers, NO prize amounts, NO button, NO people, NO cartoon mascots, NO blue sky, NO cyan, NO neon pink. No outer frame, no mockup. Full-bleed wide horizontal artwork.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied burgundy "BÔNUS VIP" banner.
The user says the background has TOO MANY DETAILS. Simplify it radically into an elegant minimal cinematic backdrop, while preserving the exact typography and promotional copy.

KEEP EXACTLY: original 1983 x 793 wide canvas, text placement and proportions, huge warm gold VIP, silver-white BÔNUS, exact bottom line "Diário + Semanal + Mensal" and its dark wine plaque. Keep every accent, character, plus sign, color and the high readability of the lettering. No new text.

CHANGE: replace ALL palace architecture, columns, arches, curtains, wall ornaments and candle stands with a completely smooth, clean matte DEEP BURGUNDY GRADIENT (#32131e to #62263c). One broad soft rose-gold glow from upper right, subtle diffuse vignette and calm shadow. Absolutely NO patterns, busy textures, particles, sparkles, beams, folds, scenery or architectural detail in the background.

On the right retain ONE jeweled gold crown resting on ONE plain purple velvet cushion. Simplify the throne behind it to a quiet, dark wine-red upholstered back with a thin understated gold edge, without carvings, filigree, tufting or baroque flourishes; it should disappear gently into the background. The crown itself can stay richly crafted but it is the ONLY detailed decorative object. Remove all loose coins, coin stacks and scattered gems from the bottom and edges. Remove any filigree flourishes from the two ends of the bottom text plaque, leaving a clean narrow border.

Style: minimal premium luxury product advertisement with cinematic lighting, substantial clean negative space, restrained materials, crisp silver-and-gold typography. Background must stay wine-red/burgundy, not purple or blue. Visual hierarchy: VIP text first, crown second, background nearly invisible. Keep text large and easily legible. No people, no brand name, no br893.com, no URL, no numbers, no watermark.
